summary: scripts/evidence-verify --members now gives the evidence log's view of a per-crate check (log, log_head, log_age_s, log_missing) over every workspace member: the log head is judged once, then each member's own key file. rust-tests decision lines said log=- before, so the flip trigger's 24-hour log window could never start. A satisfied per-crate line also says missing=0 instead of missing=-.

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: Shadow fields only: the log view never changes a decision, and the rust-tests skip policy stays enforce false.

compatibility.detail: The decision line keeps its fields; rust-tests lines now carry log values and missing=0 when satisfied.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; the lines go back to log=-.
